verdict.rationale: Runpod is GPU compute infrastructure (Pods, Serverless, Clusters), not an agent or AI application that consumes tools, so plugging MCP servers into it as an MCP client is a category error for this kind of product. The evidence that Runpod publishes its own MCP servers covers the server role, which belongs to a separate story and does not make this client axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
